signals.usability_note: Clear daytime view of a Cape Cod-style house frontage with lawn, driveway, and attached garage visible.
signals.notes: Well-kept Cape Cod with gray siding, dark shutters, and wreath on the front door; the large front lawn is mostly green with some thin and brown patches, two cars sit in the right-side driveway, and a wooden privacy fence plus an outbuilding are visible at left.
